step.script: For a projectile landing at launch height, keep launch speed fixed and ignore air resistance. How does range depend on angle?

ops.content: Fixed launch speed; equal launch and landing heights; no drag

step.script: Horizontal speed times flight time gives range. The angle dependence simplifies to sine of twice the launch angle.
Sine reaches one when twice the angle is ninety degrees. So forty-five degrees gives the greatest range.

checkpoint.question: If the launch angle increases from 45 degrees to 60 degrees, does the range increase or decrease?
checkpoint.expected_gist: It decreases, since 45 degrees gives maximum range under these assumptions.

step.script: Complementary angles have equal ranges: thirty and sixty degrees land equally far away, but sixty degrees produces a higher, longer flight.

ops.content: 30° and 60°: same range, different height and flight time
